purpose: Phase-7C validation + versioning architecture. Enumerates the version identifiers, the conditions the immune validator/frame-builder must reject, and the Section-1 foundational acceptance criteria. Part 1 - Section 1 implements the structural subset (contracts, immutability, availability, versioning, serialization, read-only boundaries); behavioural biology validation continues in later sections and Part 2.

availability_model.rule: zero means a modelled zero; unavailable means the model cannot determine the value; these are distinct.
availability_model.aggregator_rule: aggregators distinguish zero contribution / unavailable contribution / excluded contribution / not-applicable contribution.

notes: Section-1 validate() covers: registry integrity, evidence + prediction labelling, version compatibility, immutability of published frames, availability labelling (no silent zeros), state-machine structural integrity, and the read-only 7C<->8A boundary. Behavioural immune-biology validation is added when the biology sections are implemented.
